text: The Sylow theorems concern subgroups of order p^k where p is prime. The first Sylow theorem guarantees:
choices: the existence of a Sylow p-subgroup of order p^k where p^k | |G| but p^{k+1} ∤ |G|
the number of Sylow p-subgroups divides |G|/p^k
explanation: First Sylow theorem: if p^k | |G| and p^{k+1} ∤ |G|, then G has a subgroup of order p^k (a Sylow p-subgroup).
